title: upstream crosslink: quiet mode truncates titles through the human renderer
description: Upstream finding for dollspace-gay/crosslink, 2026-07-20. Defect: -q is not plumbed into issue list — quiet falls through to the human table renderer with a hardcoded 40-char title truncate (src/commands/list.rs:38 truncate(&title,40); src/utils.rs:75-84 char-count ellipsis; src/main.rs:2071-2083 branches only on json). Agents matching on titles break: two close-verification mismatches in this session's own record (statusline rounds 2 and 3 closes) trace to fragment-matching against truncated -q output. --json never truncates. Proposal: quiet should be full-fidelity machine output (or documentation should route agents to --json). Evidence class: agent-first output contract — display truncation leaking into a mode agents consume.
